drawCount.description: A fixed count, or the drawing player's own remaining Prize cards at resolution (「与自己剩余奖赏卡张数相同数量」); ifRemainingPrizes draws `then` instead of `otherwise` while exactly `equals` Prize cards remain (「如果自己的剩余奖赏卡张数为6张的话，则抽取的张数变为8张」).

oneOf.description: A count computed from the effect user's side when the effect starts, before any hand goes back (「数过自己的手牌之后…抽取与放回牌库的张数相同数量」, 「抽取与对手的手牌相同张数」, 「抽取4张。如果对手的剩余奖赏卡张数在3张及以下的话，则抽取的张数变为8张」); a negative result draws nothing.
「然后，抛掷1次硬币，如果为正面则从牌库上方抽取8张卡牌，如果为反面，则…抽取3张卡牌」: the drawing player flips 1 coin of its own when its draw is reached, after the hands went back (「双方玩家各抛掷1次硬币」: one coin each).

handDeckDraw.description: CN II.E-36 p74 then II.E-19 p62–63: whole hands into their own decks with a full-deck shuffle, then draws only if that actually happened.

drawPokemonCount.description: Draw as many cards as the named side's in-play Pokémon at resolution (Active plus Bench).

countersValue.description: 「将与…数量相同数量的伤害指示物，放置于…」, 「将…张数×N个伤害指示物，放置于…」: a counter count the printed text computes from board, zone, Prize or history facts when they are placed; none when it is 0 or less.

drawValue.description: Draw a count the printed text computes from board, zone or history facts at resolution (「抽取与…数量相同数量的卡牌」, 「抽取2张。如果…的话，则额外抽取2张」); a negative result draws nothing.

cardsThenDraw.description: One printed card movement, then (II.E-19) a dependent draw for the effect user.

nestedEffect.description: A reviewed static core leaf composed by a control handler. Its own parameter validator still applies.

discardTools.description: Put Pokémon Tools attached to that side's Pokémon into their owner's discard pile (I.B-02; II.D-03 文例1 「将放于对手场上宝可梦身上的所有「宝可梦道具」，放于弃牌区」). target: whose Tools; selector: which Tools by printed identity; the effect user chooses; Pokémon protected from this effect offer none.

side.description: both: 「放于双方场上宝可梦身上的…「宝可梦道具」」, either player's Tools in one choice.

stadium.description: 「场上的…「宝可梦道具」或「竞技场」」: the Stadium in play is one more card in the same choice (II.D-03; a Stadium protected from this effect is not offered).

to.description: 「…放于放逐区」 instead of the discard pile.

opponentHandLook.description: Before damage, look at the opponent's whole hand; the looked-at cards feed this attack's damage (「查看对手的手牌，造成其中训练家张数×N伤害」「如果其中有能量的话，则追加造成N伤害」; II.B-02, II.C-20).

countedCards.description: Before-damage discard of cards from the user's hand or deck, or a move of the user's hand or discard-pile cards to the Lost Zone, whose actual cards feed this attack's damage (「将自己手牌中任意数量的X放于弃牌区，造成其张数×N」「将自己牌库上方5张卡牌放于弃牌区，造成其中能量的张数×N」「将自己弃牌区中任意数量的X放于放逐区，追加造成其张数×N」; II.B-02).

optionalCounted.description: 「若希望，可将…放于弃牌区（／放回手牌／放回牌库）。在这种情况下，追加造成N伤害」「…追加造成其张数×N」 (II.E-10, II.B-02): before damage the user may decline; the cards actually moved (none when declined) feed this attack's damage. effect: the user's own attached Energy discarded or returned, Tools discarded, the user's hand/deck cards discarded, or the Stadium in play discarded.

countedEnergyDiscard.description: Before-damage discard of attached Energy whose actual card count feeds this attack's damage (II.B-02, II.D-02 文例1), or the opponent's 「在造成伤害前，选择附着于对手战斗宝可梦身上的1个特殊能量，放于弃牌区」 (I.A-01 step 3).

coin.description: II.C-05: flip once; only the printed result runs the effect, or several printed effects in order (「则A，并B」).

oneOf.description: 「抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则选择1种特殊状态，使对手的战斗宝可梦陷入该特殊状态」: the printed result leads to one choice (effects.choose-one).

otherwise.description: 「如果为正面则A，如果为反面则B」: what the other face does.

coins.description: Several flips, or flips until tails, then by how many show `face`: scale = the nested leaf is written for ONE such flip (「与出现正面次数相同数量」, 「出现正面次数×3张」) and the host multiplies its count; all = 「如果全部都是正面」; atLeast = 「如果出现2次以上正面」.

oneOf.description: 「抛掷与自己场上的「X」数量相同次数的硬币」: this many flips, read when the flips start (0 flips nothing).

coinResult.description: An attack's later effect decided by the coins its own damage already flipped (II.E-38 文例3: 「抛掷3次硬币，造成正面次数×100点伤害。如果全部为反面，则…」). condition reads only coin facts of rolls this attack declares.

when.description: 「如果〈条件〉（的话），则A」, optionally 「如果不是，则B」 (otherwise): judged on the board when this instruction is reached. effects = several results of one condition, in order. The condition reads use-time facts only: no coin, counted-effect, Prizes-taken or damage-target read; a Trainer or Energy has no 「这只宝可梦」.

optional.description: II.E-10: 「若希望，可……」 the user may decline the whole following effect (never a smaller printed quantity). 「若希望，可A。在这种情况下，B」: a cn.then@1 effect.

oneOf.description: 「若希望，可让对手将对手自己的所有手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。在这种情况下，对手从牌库上方抽取4张卡牌」「若希望，可令对手重洗其牌库」.

thenMoved.description: CN II.E-19 p62–63 with the cards A actually moved: 「将最多2张手牌放于弃牌区，抽取其张数×2张」 (use count: B's count, written for one such card, times the cards moved), 「将牌库上方3张卡牌放于弃牌区，将其中所有能量，附着于这只宝可梦身上」 (use cards: B takes only those cards), 「选择…1张【水】宝可梦，放于备战区。然后，…附着于该宝可梦身上」 (use pokemon: B acts only on the Pokémon A put into play, attached Energy to, moved Energy to or healed). B runs only if A moved at least one card (affected a Pokémon).

optional.description: 「若希望，可将该宝可梦…」: with use pokemon, the user may decline the next part.

then.description: CN II.E-19 p62–63: 「A。然后，B」 or 「如果成功执行A了的话，则B」: B runs only if A was at least partly performed.

oneOf.description: 「然后，使新出场的宝可梦陷入【中毒】和【睡眠】状态」: B is several printed steps, run in order.
「…。然后，抛掷1次硬币如果为正面，则…」: B is one coin (cn.coin@1, its own validator applies).

discardDeckTop.description: Put the top cards of the named side's deck into its owner's discard pile (II.C-01; II.A: as many as the deck holds).

to.description: 「将对手牌库上方的N张卡牌，放于放逐区」: into the deck holder's Lost Zone instead.

attachThenDraw.description: One effect attachment from hand or discard, then (II.E-19) a dependent draw for the effect user.

energyOptions.description: An alternative cost of this attack; condition: 「这个招式，如果……的话，则仅需……便可使用」, judged when the attack could be declared.

countedSwitch.description: 「选择对手的1只备战宝可梦，将其与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，给新出场的宝可梦造成N伤害」: the switch runs before damage and records the Pokémon that came in (none when nothing was switched), so the attack's damage formula can require it.

switch.description: CN C-03—05: explicitly identify the switched side, choosing player relative to the source, and affected Active or selected Bench Pokémon.

affected.description: source: this effect's own Benched Pokémon becomes the Active Pokémon (「将这只宝可梦与战斗宝可梦互换」).

selector.description: Only Benched Pokémon matching this may come in (「与备战区中的【雷】宝可梦互换」「选择对手备战区中的1只【基础】宝可梦」).

activeSelector.description: 「将自己战斗场上的【基础】宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换」: only while the Active Pokémon matches this (current stage and types).

outgoingHeal.description: 「然后，回复被换入备战区的宝可梦「N」点HP」: the Pokémon that actually moved from the Active Spot to the Bench, after the switch.

bottom.description: 「从自己的牌库下方抽取N张卡牌」: drawn one by one from the deck bottom.

opponentMayDraw.description: 「对手若希望，可从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (count N), 「…。在这种情况下，自己额外从牌库上方抽取M张卡牌」 (ownDraw M): the opponent decides (II.E-10); the user's draw follows only when the opponent drew.

drawPlayers.description: 「双方玩家，各从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (own N, opponent N) or 「对手从牌库上方抽取N张卡牌」 (own 0): the effect user draws first, then the opponent; a player with too few cards draws what there is (II.A).

side.description: event (with target event): 「给双方所有…宝可梦」 in a per-Pokémon trigger, the event Pokémon of either player.

targets.description: 「给对手的2只备战宝可梦身上，各放置1个伤害指示物」: distinct Pokémon, each receiving count.

all.description: 「给对手所有的（…）宝可梦身上，各放置N个」: every matching Pokémon, no choice.

countersFromDamage.description: 「当这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，将与受到的伤害数值相同的伤害指示物，放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上」: in an attack-damage reaction, damage ÷ 10 counters (the damage after Weakness and Resistance).

countersUntil.description: 「在对手（战斗）宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「N」（点）（为止）」: the number of counters is (remaining HP − N) ÷ 10, the remaining HP (II.D-16) read when they are placed; none when it is already N or less (II.C-07).

all.description: 「给对手所有的备战宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP均变为「N」为止」: every Pokémon of the target (any/bench), each to its own N, no choice.

stadiumUse.description: A Stadium effect a player may declare 「每次在自己的回合有1次机会」 (I.B-04): once per player per turn under this card's own key; the effect is a reviewed static leaf or one cn.then@1 (「可A。在这种情况下，B」), a whole-hand pair with printed counts (「可将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗牌库。在这种情况下，可从自己的牌库上方抽取5张卡牌」), one coin (「可抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则…」) or one condition on the using player (「在这个回合，从手牌使出了支援者的玩家，可…」). endsTurn: 「在这种情况下，自己的回合结束」 after it resolves (II.E-20 文例3).

countedReveal.description: Before damage, cards turned face up or shown to the opponent are recorded for this attack's formula; they stay where they are (II.B-02). deck: 「将自己牌库上方N张卡牌翻到正面」, all N recorded (count a kind with movedCards). discard: 「将自己弃牌区中的所有X给对手查看」, every matching card. hand: 「将自己手牌中任意数量的X给对手查看」, the cards the user shows.

revealedCards.description: After damage, the cards an earlier cn.countedReveal@1 of the same attack (effectId) recorded go on: to (deck = into the deck, then shuffle). With selector only the matching ones go to `to`; the others go to rest (a deck-top reveal only: 「将正面朝上的X放于弃牌区，剩余的卡牌放回牌库并重洗牌库」). Cards no longer in their zone are skipped.

countedDeckTop.description: Before damage, 「（双方各）将牌库上方N张卡牌放于弃牌区，追加造成其中能量张数×N」: the discarded cards are recorded for this attack's formula; both = the user's deck first, then the opponent's.

countedSelfCounters.description: Before damage, 「给这只宝可梦身上放置最多N个伤害指示物，造成放置的伤害指示物数量×M伤害」: the user picks 0 to N; the number placed is recorded for this attack's formula (effectCards).

countValue.description: A printed count computed when the effect resolves (「与…数量相同数量」「…张数×N个」「最多与…相同张数」): effect is written for a count of 1 (count 1, or quantity exact/upTo 1) and the host puts the value there; nothing happens at 0 or less.

deployIncomingThen.description: 「将这只宝可梦放于自己的备战区。然后，…」 in a beforeHand Ability: next (a static leaf, or one cn.coin@1) only once this card was placed (II.E-19).

ifPaid.description: 「在这种情况下，…」 after an Item/Supporter's optional play cost (effects.optional-cost): effect (or effects, in order) only when the cost was paid. otherwise: only the 「将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。…在这种情况下，回复被换到备战区的宝可梦「N」点HP」 form — effect is a cn.switch@1 with outgoingHeal and otherwise the same switch without it.

gameResult.description: II.E-38 「这场对战（算作）自己的胜利」 (win) / 「这场对战己方败北」 (lose): the game ends here with that result, outside the I.E checks.

turnEndEffect.description: II.E-20 「使用了这张卡牌的回合结束时，（如果〈条件〉的话，则）…」 on an Item/Supporter: recorded when the card is used, performed when this turn ends (after the attack, or ending the turn without one) and before the checkup; condition is judged then.

returnSelf.description: 「不将这张「X」放于弃牌区，而是放回手牌」 (default) / 「…而是放回牌库并重洗牌库」 (to deckShuffle): the Item/Supporter in use.

deploySelf.description: 「将这张卡牌放于备战区。（然后，…）」 in an Ability used from hand or discard (zone): this card onto its owner's Bench; next (a static leaf, or one cn.coin@1) only once it was placed (II.E-19), with 「这只宝可梦」 = the Pokémon it became.

revealHands.description: 「双方玩家，各将自己的手牌翻到正面，互相展示」: both hands are shown to both players; nothing moves.

evolutionPermission.description: This Pokémon's own evolution permission (effects.program evolutionPermission without op/scope).

chooseOne.description: 「这张卡牌，可以从2个效果中选择1个使用。◆A ◆B」「选择1种特殊状态，使…陷入该特殊状态」「选择自己或对手，被选择的玩家…」 (II.A, II.D-04): the effect user chooses one printed option that could change something now (effects.choose-one). An option is one entry or the entries of one ◆ in order.

knockOut.description: 「令这只宝可梦／对手的战斗宝可梦／使用了招式的宝可梦【昏厥】」, 「选择对手备战区中的N只…宝可梦，令其【昏厥】」 (I.D): Knocked Out at the end of the effect, regardless of HP. self = this Pokémon (no side); otherwise side + active/attacker, or bench/any with count = the user chooses that many of the matching Pokémon (selector, state).

cure.description: 「恢复（这只宝可梦／自己的战斗宝可梦／对手的战斗宝可梦）的所有特殊状态」: every listed Special Condition it has is recovered (conditions absent = all five; 「恢复【中毒】状态」 = ['poisoned']). count = 「恢复N个特殊状态」: the user chooses N of the listed ones it has (all when it has no more).

cureAll.description: 「回复…HP，并恢复其全部特殊状态」: the same Pokémon also recovers from every Special Condition it has; it may then be chosen when it has one, even undamaged.

sleepCoins.description: 「因这个【睡眠】而抛掷的硬币次数变为2次，只要不是全为正面就不会恢复」 (asleep only).

confusionCounters.description: 「因这个【混乱】而放置的伤害指示物数量变为6个」 (confused only).

stages.description: Printed stage of each affected Pokémon, e.g. 「身上放有这张卡牌的【基础】宝可梦」「所有【2阶进化】宝可梦」.

perEnergyType.description: hp only: amount × the Energy units attached to the affected Pokémon that can provide this type now (「这只宝可梦身上每附有1个【钢】能量，这只宝可梦的最大HP就会增加「20」点」).

condition.description: 「如果追加附有3个【火】能量的话，…。在这种情况下，这个招式的伤害不计算…」: the flags apply only while this holds when the damage is calculated (attack facts such as extraEnergy).

extraPrizes.description: 「如果因为这个招式的伤害，对手的（【基础】）宝可梦【昏厥】的话，则多拿取N张奖赏卡」 (attacks only).

quantity.description: upTo 「最多N个」; all 「（放置的）全部／所有伤害指示物」 (no count); any 「任意数量的伤害指示物，（以任意方式）转放于…」: one counter at a time, from any origin, each to a destination the player chooses, until they stop (with count: 「选择放置于自己场上宝可梦身上的最多N个伤害指示物」, at most N in all).

originSelector.description: 「选择自己备战区中的1只「古代」宝可梦」: the origin's printed kind.

originSide.description: 「对手场上（1只）宝可梦身上放置的…」 / 「双方场上宝可梦身上放置的…」; absent = the user's own Pokémon.

targetSelector.description: 「转放于自己其他【超】宝可梦身上」: the destination's kind.

each.description: 「自己所有宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物各N个」 (from every): each origin gives N counters (all it has, if fewer).

split.description: 「以任意方式转放于…」: each moved counter goes to a destination the player chooses.

type.description: The named Basic Energy type, or null for any Basic Energy card.

types.description: 「【超】或【钢】能量」: a Basic Energy card of any of these types; type is then null.

category.description: 「能量」 (any Energy card, II.C-09) or 「特殊能量」; absent = Basic Energy only. With a category, type is null. A Special Energy attached to a Pokémon it cannot be attached to is discarded (II.C-10 FAQ2).

target.description: Attach only to this effect's own Pokémon (「附着于这只宝可梦身上」), or to the user's Active Pokémon (「附着于战斗宝可梦身上」).

exact.description: 「选择…中的N张…，附着于」 without 「最多」: exactly N, or all there are if fewer (II.D-04); absent = 1 to N.

anyNumber.description: 「任意数量的…能量」 (II.D-02): any number, none included; count is then 60, the whole deck.

recipient.description: Printed in-play predicate of each recipient, e.g. a 「古代」 tag.

distribution.description: singleRecipient: all chosen cards go to one Pokémon (「附着于1只…身上」). separateRecipients: each Pokémon receives at most one (「各附着1张」). Absent: each card chooses freely.

spareKnockOut.description: 「（对会被【昏厥】的宝可梦，无法使用这个特性。）」: no recipient whose remaining HP (II.D-16) the recipient counters would use up.

nameKeys.description: 「选择自己手牌中的1张「治疗能量」」: only Energy cards of these names (with the category the card is printed in).
